The role sits at the intersection of revenue operations, process engineering, and customer delivery. You will design the internal systems & SOPs that drive lead generation and outreach, maintain the revenue funnel, and continuously operate and optimize them.
This is a unique, high-velocity residential role based out of our Hacker House in Bangalore. You will be living in our Hacker House and working alongside the founder, offering unprecedented, daily 1-on-1 mentorship, rapid decision-making, and direct exposure to startup strategy, product, and enterprise deal closing.
If you think in systems and processes, enjoy implementing them by interfacing with different teams, then measure their efficiency with data and reports to come up with improvements (rinse & repeat), this high-impact role is built for you. Key Responsibilities Lead Funnel Management : Design, maintain & continuously optimize the end-to-end lead funnel, from lead generation to deal closure, for both inbound & outbound channels. Founder’s Office Operations : Work directly with the Founder on strategic initiatives, process design, and operational improvements. Who You Are Experience : 3 - 5 years of experience in operations, growth, consulting, or founder’s office roles in a tech company. CRM & Pipeline : Strong understanding of CRM systems and revenue pipeline management. Ability to coordinate between technical teams and business stakeholders. AI, Automation & Tool Savvy : Experience integrating tools through AI, APIs, automation scripts, or low-code workflows. Familiarity with AI agents like OpenClaw/Claude Code to automate workflows or analyze data.
